name: Uniform-Oriented-Matroid Fibers Are Maximum-Generated
scope: Finite concept classes after fixed coordinates are suppressed.
statement: Every uniform-oriented-matroid fiber is a pc-minor of a finite maximum class.
proof: Choose one prescribed sign. The corresponding uniform-oriented-matroid tope halfspace is maximum; imposing the remaining prescribed signs is a convex restriction of that maximum class. Cubes are maximum themselves.
comments: Whether the reverse inclusion holds is open and is equivalent to every finite maximum class being a uniform-oriented-matroid fiber.
